data.name: Mirabella
data.gender_notes: Mirabella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin mirabilis, meaning admirable, marvelous, or beautiful. The name Mirabella carries the meaning “admirable, marvelous, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mirabella usually hope their child will grow to embody admirable, marvelous, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mirabella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “admirable, marvelous, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirabella total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: מירבלה
in_hebrew.meaning: מירבלה היא שם שפירושו נערה נפלאה או מופלאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מירבלה היא שם שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו נערה נפלאה או מופלאה. השם מורכב מהמילים 'מירא' שפירושו נפלא או מופלא ו-'בלה' שפירושו יפה או נערה. השם מירבלה הוא שם נוצרי שמשמעותו רוחנית וקשורה ליופי ולקדושה.

in_greek.name: Μιραμπέλα
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Μιραμπέλα σημαίνει ένα κορίτσι υπέροχο ή θαυμαστό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μιραμπέλα προέρχεται από το Λατινικό και σημαίνει ένα κορίτσι υπέροχο ή θαυμαστό. Το όνομα αποτελείται από τις λέξεις 'mira' που σημαίνει υπέροχο ή θαυμαστό και 'bella' που σημαίνει όμορφο ή κορίτσι. Το όνομα Μιραμπέλα είναι ένα Χριστιανικό όνομα που συνδέεται με την πνευματικότητα και την ομορφιά.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mirabella has a rich history and cultural significance, particularly in Italy where it originated. It evokes images of beauty, wonder, and admiration. The name has been popularized in various forms of art, literature, and media, representing a character or idea that is breathtaking, enchanting, or inspiring. In Italian culture, the given name Mirabella is often associated with the Virgin Mary, symbolizing her beauty, grace, and divine intercession.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Mirabella is a reminder of the awe-inspiring presence of God in our lives. It encourages us to gaze upon the wonders of creation and behold the beauty of God's infinite love and mercy. The name Mirabella challenges us to marvel at the mysteries of faith and to live our lives as a reflection of God's splendor. It is a call to be admirable and beautiful in the eyes of God, striving for holiness and sanctity in all that we do.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mirabella, meaning "admirable, wonderful to behold," is a name that evokes a sense of awe and reverence. It is a reminder of the beauty and majesty of God's creation and the wonders of the spiritual world. May those bearing this name be inspired to live admirably and radiate joy and wonder in their own lives.

historical_references.reference: According to legend, Mirabella was a 13th century Italian noblewoman who was renowned for her beauty and kindness. She was said to have raised a dragon as a pet, and when she was threatened by invaders, she called upon the dragon to protect her and her people. After the battle, Mirabella asked the dragon to depart, but it refused, vowing to stay by her side until she needed it again.

Mirabella was also the name of a Spanish nun and mystic who lived in the late 15th and early 16th centuries. She was known for her spiritual visions and ecstatic experiences, and was particularly revered for her devotion to the Blessed Virgin Mary. Mirabella's writings and teachings continue to be studied and admired by spiritual seekers to this day.
